title: Arch Capital Group Ltd. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: Arch Capital Group Ltd. filed an 8-K on April 19, 2026 disclosing a $3.0 billion increase to its existing share repurchase program authorization. As of April 20, 2026, approximately $3.1 billion remained available for future share repurchases under the program.
key_points: Arch Capital Group Ltd. increased its share repurchase authorization by $3.0 billion on April 19, 2026.
As of April 20, 2026, approximately $3.1 billion is available for share repurchases under the program.
Repurchases may be executed in open market or privately negotiated transactions.
Timing and amount of repurchases will depend on market conditions and corporate/regulatory considerations.
Filing signed by François Morin, Executive Vice President, CFO and Treasurer.
